description: TACKLE COMMITMENT 1 - REACH. match::player AI standing-tackle decide 0x1441a7fa0: an AI defender only commits when the predicted ball-carrier position is within 2.0 m and the ball itself within 1.7 m. Widens to 2.5 m / 2.0 m by re-aiming two RIP disp32s at existing pool cells. The decide is pure geometry - there is no probability roll anywhere in the chain - so a wider gate is a directly proportional increase in challenges. Affects CPU opponents, the human's AI team-mates AND the human's own cursor player (assisted tackle). A hard 3.0 m test at 0x1441a831f caps the first number, so this cannot run away. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove <this file>

patches.name: standing-tackle reach to predicted carrier position 2.0 -> 2.5 m
